title: Local refinement with ≤4nm perturbation bounds around round-3 optimum
scientific_hypothesis: The round-3 optimum (target_score 0.3379) resides in a narrow local basin; constraining perturbations to ≤4nm (~1% of mean thickness) with 40 additional deterministic steps will reveal whether further spectral overlap improvement exists within this basin without escaping to distant local minima.
design_principle: Hybrid refinement pass: extract top candidate from round-3, apply bounded perturbation optimization with tight amplitude constraints to maximize spectral overlap while maintaining proximity to known good solution.
proposed_topology: Air | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | ZnSe | ZnS | Ge substrate (16 finite layers, alternating starting with ZnSe)
design_variables: Layer thicknesses with ±4nm perturbation bounds centered on round-3 best candidate thicknesses
manufacturing_considerations: Thickness tolerance ±4nm represents tight but achievable deposition control
theory_basis: Local gradient-based optimization converges faster when initialized near optimum with tight bounds
Quarter-wave stack theory suggests spectral features are sensitive to ~λ/4n thickness variations
expected_advantages: Faster convergence due to reduced search space
Maintains proximity to known good solution
Tests whether current optimum is truly local maximum
known_risks: May be trapped in same local minimum if basin is flat
4nm constraint may be too tight to escape shallow local optimum
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer alternating ZnSe/ZnS multilayer on Ge substrate. Initialize all layer thicknesses at the round-3 best candidate values: [1128.0, 872.0, 479.0, 229.0, 409.0, 964.0, 876.0, 1271.0, 498.0, 463.0, 452.0, 402.0, 277.0, 938.0, 733.0, 1255.0] nm. Constrain each layer thickness optimization bounds to ±4nm around these initialization values. Run 40 deterministic gradient-based optimization steps. Objective: maximize mean transmittance in 8000-11000nm band while minimizing mean transmittance in 3000-5000nm band. Normal incidence, unpolarized illumination. Report final thicknesses, target_score, and robustness_score. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Implements feedback directive for hybrid refinement pass with ≤4nm perturbation constraints and 40 additional optimization steps focused on spectral overlap maximization around round-3 optimum.
